title: Renewed MC
description: A simple modpack that introduces quality of life mods while maintaining the vanilla experience.
body:
![Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24d4d8e88fdd1d2611deebd1b2abb4aa1d52d79a.png)

# Introduction !
A totally immersive and realistic experience while maintaining the vanilla experience we love so much. Best of all, the performance is still very stable and with high frames per second !!!! Finally, this modpack was made with everything the author likes and with a lot of care involved, I hope you enjoy the experience.
##  Features :
- **New Particles (Ambience,Particular,Effective,Etc.)**
- **New Animations (Fresh Animations,Not Enough Animations,Serious Player Animations.)**
- **New Graphics (Iris,Fog,Etc.)**
- **And More (Smooth Gui,3D Itens)**
